purpose: Compare portable memory candidate against unchanged pinned source-built prover; released module is an additional control
larger_input: No independently expected larger retained input currently available; cannot claim larger-workload gains
ordering: alternate baseline,candidate and candidate,baseline by pair; fresh Worker per proof
summary: median paired candidate/baseline ratios, each workload separately

boundaries.load: fetch, hash, compile and instantiate inside Worker, before init
boundaries.prove: spike_prove call including PIE parsing and result copy
boundaries.fresh_worker_total: Worker creation through proof receipt in parent
boundaries.requested_rust_peak: cumulative allocator requested peak in fresh instance
boundaries.linear_memory: instance memory byteLength; memory can only grow
boundaries.process_peak: 500 ms sampled summed Chromium-family RSS; shared pages may be double counted, transient peaks may be missed; not private memory or a hard peak
boundaries.retention: separate repeated-proof session; cannot use cumulative peak as per-phase peak

failed_attempts: Retain all attempts, timeouts and OOMs. No ratios if either side fails stability.
smoke_validation: One corpus traversal is a correctness smoke check and is not this benchmark campaign.
